idea-plugin.name: Agent Refs [Beta]
idea-plugin.description:
English

Agent Refs [Beta] copies precise code references from the IntelliJ IDEA editor to the clipboard, so you can paste them straight into a coding agent without manually typing file paths or line numbers. It also opens the current project in the agent app you use.

Platform support: Opening an agent app supports Windows and macOS. Copying code references is available on every platform.

  • Pick an agent from the Open Agent dropdown in the main toolbar to open the current project in it. Codex and ZCode are configured out of the box.
  • Add, remove or reorder agents, and customize their Windows PowerShell and macOS shell commands, under Settings | Tools | Agent Refs.
  • Copy selected code with its project-relative file path and exact line range; double-clicking a method or variable behaves exactly like a manual selection.
  • Copy the selected code reference, or the current file reference when there is no selection, from the editor context menu using Copy as Code Reference, placed right above Copy / Paste Special, or with Ctrl+Shift+C.
  • References go to the clipboard, ready to paste into any agent.

Project paths are resolved to their real absolute locations before an agent app is launched.

中文

Agent Refs [Beta] 用于在 IntelliJ IDEA 里把选中的代码复制成准确的代码引用， 直接粘贴给编码 Agent，无需手动拼写文件路径和行号；同时支持一键用当前项目打开常用的 Agent 应用。

平台支持：打开 Agent 支持 Windows 和 macOS；复制代码引用在所有平台都可以使用。

  • 通过主工具栏右侧的 Open Agent 下拉菜单，用当前项目打开对应的 Agent 应用；默认内置 Codex 与 ZCode。
  • 在 Settings | Tools | Agent Refs 中增删 Agent，并自定义各自的 Windows PowerShell 与 macOS 命令。
  • 复制选中的代码，自动携带项目相对路径和准确行号范围；双击方法或变量与手动选中代码的行为完全一致。
  • 通过编辑器右键菜单中的 Copy as Code Reference（位于 Copy / Paste Special 上方）或快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+C 复制选中的代码引用；未选中代码时复制当前文件引用。
  • 引用只会复制到剪贴板，可以直接粘贴到任意 Agent 的输入框。

插件会先将项目路径解析为真实绝对路径，再启动对应的 Agent 应用。
